module: Flowgraph node "Race CP/Lap Change" (category repeat_instant). Lets a flow (changed pulse) through when a vehicle's checkpoint or lap changes, based on the race state events (rollingStarted, pathnodeReached, raceStarted, lapComplete, raceComplete). Outputs: flow, changed, curCP (linear index of the current checkpoint), maxCP (number of pathnodes), curLap (current lap, 1-based), maxLap (race.lapCount), recoveryReached and usedRecovery.
notes: A block of code is disabled by "if false and ..." (reset of the race markers): it is dead.

work.desc: Every frame: copies flow, and if a checkpoint/lap event occurred for vehId, updates curCP, maxCP, curLap, maxLap, changed, recoveryReached and usedRecovery.
